name: LUNA
source:
In a world corrupted by superpowers, powerful enemies have plunged society into chaos. Can Luna, through her mysterious superpower, defeat the nearly invincible enigmatic women and bring peace?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437200/LUNA/]Steam[/url]
translation:
在一个因超能力而腐败堕落的世界里，强大的敌人使整个社会陷入混乱。露娜能否凭借她神秘的超能力，击败那些近乎无敌的神秘女性，为世界带来和平？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437200/LUNA/]Steam[/url]]
